features.quote: Turn cap (default 40): the loop stops after this many model invocations.
features.justification_quote: The cost objective requires a hard bound; without it, a spiraling model could loop until token limits

features.quote: Token cap (optional, `turn_budget_tokens`): stops if cumulative tokens exceed a budget.
features.justification_quote: provides a second failsafe so a single pathological run can't blow the budget

features.quote: Giving the model an explicit `finish` tool lets a graceful model *stop on its own* when it realizes the task is impossible.
features.justification_quote: This is critical for signal validity

features.quote: The timeout (default 30s) ensures the tool returns a failure result rather than hanging the whole loop indefinitely
features.justification_quote: which would make the run non-terminating and expensive
